title: Improved context-quality screens and source traceability
points: Structured valuation, ratio, and net-cash answers now recover source-page previews from curated views so trace outputs show the statement pages behind computed tables.
ROIC plus earnings-yield screens now use aligned statement model inputs and current market-cap data, returning ranked top-10 tables with usable-period coverage instead of collapsing to one company.
Free-cash-flow yield screens now use a deterministic compute stage with financial-sector exclusions, current market-data filters, and outlier guards.
Narrative lanes preserve earlier candidate pages when a later SQL attempt returns no rows, preventing valid announcement evidence from being erased before fallback submission.
EV-per-ton requests now retrieve debt, market-cap, and capacity evidence explicitly, and analyst answers must not label market-cap-less-cash proxies as enterprise value when debt inputs are missing.
